reviews.name: Eric M. (Etsy)
reviews.text: Fixed my cracked knuckles in 3 days. I've tried every lotion at the drugstore and this is the only thing that works without feeling greasy.

reviews.name: Leila K. (Etsy)
reviews.text: This bug spray is the truth. Sat outside all evening in the South Carolina humidity and didn't get a single bite.

reviews.name: Kim T. (Etsy)
reviews.text: The sleep salve is literal magic. I rub it on my temples and I'm out in 10 minutes. Smells incredible too.

reviews.name: Morgan D.
reviews.text: Smells earthy and subtle without overpowering. Softened my beard noticeably after a week of daily use.

reviews.name: Taylor R.
reviews.text: Best bath soak after a long hike in the Blue Ridge. The epsom salt and cedarwood blend melts tension away.

reviews.name: Jordan P.
reviews.text: Smooth and long-lasting balm that holds up against mountain wind. Love the gentle, clean formula.

reviews.name: Casey W.
reviews.text: Ultra-rich whipped texture that sinks right in. Completely rescued my dry elbows and winter skin.

reviews.name: Riley H.
reviews.text: Refreshing mist that clears heavy energy from my workspace. The cedar and sage note combination is perfect.

reviews.name: Sam B.
reviews.text: Brewing a giant herbal tea bag directly in the bath is a game changer. No floating mess and totally relaxing.

reviews.name: Alex M.
reviews.text: Incredibly soft shirt with vibrant screen printing. Fits true to size and survived numerous washes without shrinking.

reviews.name: Devon S.
reviews.text: A soothing bedtime bath ritual. The lavender is genuine essential oil, not fake perfume.

reviews.name: Avery G.
reviews.text: Great crisp aroma, though I wish the rosemary scent lingered a bit longer in large open rooms.
